# FDGA062

> AVOID placing comments at the end of a line even when the comment is very short.

Framework Design Guidelines, 3rd edition, section A.3 Comments.

This is a coding style convention. The book treats the appendix A conventions as suggestions, so you can override it.

## How it is checked

- Check: judgment
- Automatic fix: no
- Severity: library warning, application warning, test warning
- Status: verified

planned-analyzer: comments at the end of a line.

## From the book

```csharp
//Avoid
public class ArrayList
{
    private int count; // -1 indicates uninitialized array
}
```
